author: hattrill
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S6 KINASE (PTHR15508)
RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S6 KINASE-LIKE 1 (PTHR15508:SF4) 
LD24550P (PTHR15508:SF8) 

Would it be possible to see if you could review this family for PAINTing? In particular, adding NOT protein kinase activity to the [RSKL family](https://www.creative-enzymes.com/resource/rskl-family_89.html)

Looks like these subfamilies 
RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S6 KINASE-LIKE 1 (PTHR15508:SF4) 
LD24550P (PTHR15508:SF8)
are pseudokinases


@sjm41 and I have added: NOT protein kinase activity to
Q20821 (ISS)
Q9Y6S9 (ISS)
Q9VEA9 (ISS)
Q96S38 (IDA)
(PMID:12077123) 

Think that this would be very useful, as I can see a lot of positive annotations to this family across species from various pipelines e.g. https://www.alliancegenome.org/gene/HGNC:20222

Would be nice to see if PAINTing would work here.

(Have asked UniProt to take a look at these entries as well)
title: PAINT request: Request to review RIBOSOMAL PROTEIN S6 KINASE (PTHR15508)

author: marcfeuermann
body: This is weird. I have no MF nor BP annotations for this family. Only a few CCs. So the annotations should disappear. I will let the ticket open for the moment, until I understand the issue.

author: hattrill
body:
Hi @marcfeuermann There are no erroneous IBAs - I am wondering if, when our NOTs come through that you could propagate the negatives (via IKR) to these nodes. It could help block other IEA pipelines from adding positive ones to these families. 

(might not be do-able, but thought it was worth asking)

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hi @hattrill , thanks for the information. I was confused. Of course I will propagate the negative annotations. If there are NOT primary annotations, I should get them and be able to propagate them. 
We could even speed up the process if you gave me the references and sequences to tag. I could directly create the negative annotations and propagate them with PAINT. A few would be sufficient for propagation to the whole family.
We really need more such annotations to improve the models (as well as to feed correctly AI for predictions).
No idea if this will help to block other IEA pipelines from adding positive annotations, but at least we will have the EXP and IBA negative ones.
Cheers,
Marc.

author: hattrill
body: Currenty, we've only added one NOT for UniProtKS:Q96S38 from an experimental source. I'll have a look later and see if I can find some more negative ones to others in the family.

author: marcfeuermann
body: Okay perfect. I could already make the annotation for Q96S38 if you agree. For propagation it is enough. The others are not urgent.

author: marcfeuermann
body: Done. I've created an IKR for Q96S38 and for Q9Y6S9 from the same reference and propagated it to the whole family. Hope this will help. Cheers, Marc.
